verdict.summary: LEAP India scores 18/100 and fails the Trend Template on 7 of 8 criteria (price below all key moving averages, which are flat/entangled around ₹151, and 18.8% off the 52-week high). This is a hard gate failure under Minervini's rules — no fundamental strength, however real, can override a broken trend. The stock is also fundamentally noisy: recent EPS growth is heavily inflated by other income (25-36% of PBT across recent quarters), ROE/ROCE are weak (8%), debt-to-equity is elevated (2.1x), free cash flow is negative, and share count has roughly quadrupled in 2 years — all inconsistent with the earnings-quality profile Minervini demands even before technicals are considered. Reject, avoid, no trade plan.

weaknesses: Fails Trend Template on 7/8 criteria — price below 50/150/200 DMA, all three DMAs flat and converged, no confirmed uptrend
Earnings quality compromised: other income was 25-36% of PBT in recent quarters (red flag OTHER_INCOME_DRIVEN)
ROE 8.1% / ROCE 8.3% — well below the 17% quality bar
Negative FCF (-₹94cr latest year), only 1 of 3 years FCF-positive
D/E 2.12x with interest coverage only 3.8x — weak balance sheet
Share count up ~300% in 2 years — severe dilution
No valid base structure yet (base still 18.8% below pivot, deep 25% base)
RS percentile unverifiable (data gap), institutional sponsorship data incomplete
